issues.detail: The Greek text says 'ου γαρ' (for he did not), but the Vietnamese translation adds a negation 'không' to the verb 'sai' (send). In the original Greek, the main verb is 'απεστειλεν' (sent), and the negation 'ου' applies to the entire proposition of why He sent Him. The Vietnamese structure makes it sound like God 'did not send' Him, whereas the Greek says He 'did not send' Him *in order to judge*.
